category_title: Typically developing students without identified behavior problems
scenario_title: Passive engagement drift during presentation of new material
minimal_context: The student is sitting in an academic classroom listening to the teacher present new material.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: I am going to present the new material for today's lesson. Please just sit quietly and observe while I go through these slides.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Sits quietly, passively attending to the instruction by tracking the teacher with their eyes, as they are not required to do anything other than listen.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let me pause here for a few minutes to find the next file on my computer.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Raises a hand to get the teacher's attention during the pause.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: (Continues looking at the computer screen) Just hold on.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Drops hand after not being acknowledged. Looks away from the front of the room and begins texting on a phone, engaging in an off-task activity incompatible with any assigned task since it is down time and no expectations are apparent.)
